exposure: Infants genetically predisposed to T1D and CD
Number of respiratory infections or febrile infections in the 9 months preceding the appearance of islet antibodies
cohort: Infants at risk for developing type 1 diabetes and celiac disease.
finding: Genetic predisposition and environmental factors, including diet, infections, and the microbiome, are closely interrelated in the pathogenesis of type 1 diabetes and celiac disease.
mod_finding: Method of birth can alter the composition of the microbiome, which may play a role in the pathogenesis of type 1 diabetes.
